sources.text:
# Atlas release plan

This is a fictional test document, supplied under the repository's MIT license.

The Atlas team plans the release for October 12, 2026. The release owner is Jordan.
The remaining blocker is the payment-service load test. The release can proceed after
that test passes and the rollback rehearsal is complete.
